Submission Date: 10/18/2026

documents.name: 151634.txt
documents.text:
KENNETH WIDMER, Wasilla, AK.
A Data Center in Cook Inlet should never be allowed.The Beluga whales in the inlet are in decline and a Data Center could be so disruptive that it could contribute to their extinction. In addition Cook Inlet is a migratory route for thousands of salmon that could be negatively impacted.
